Site Reliability Engineer
Northwind Telehealth

FICTIONAL job post for tests.

Northwind Telehealth connects patients with doctors by video in six countries. Uptime matters: a dropped call is a missed appointment. Our services are written in Go and run on Kubernetes in two regions.

What you'll do
- Define SLOs with service teams and build the dashboards and alerts that track them.
- Roll out OpenTelemetry tracing across our Go services and the video gateway.
- Run Prometheus and Grafana, and reduce noisy alerts.
- Lead incident response and blameless postmortems; join a fair on-call rotation.
- Do capacity planning and load testing before big launches.
- Automate toil with Go and Terraform.

What you bring
- 4+ years in SRE, platform or backend roles.
- Production Go.
- Kubernetes and Docker.
- Monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.
- Experience with PostgreSQL and Redis in production.

Nice to have
- OpenTelemetry.
- Experience in healthcare or other regulated industries.
- gRPC.

Compensation: $85,000 to $115,000. Remote, UTC to UTC+8.
